QuestInfo.name: [Phantom Forest] Inscrutable
QuestInfo.0: Taggrin has something to ask of you. See what he wants.
QuestInfo.1: Taggrin says that something that looked like the ancient Archdemon Naricain was recently sighted in the Phantom Forest and asks you to defeat it, whatever it is. He says that it should appear if you defeat many of the elite knights who appear when you vanquish spirits in the forest.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the Phantom of Naricain, which was threatening the Phantom Forest.

mob.0: If you happen to encounter the monster, which people call the Phantom of Naricain, please eliminate it at all costs.
